text.en: A table lamp with contemporary design, characterized by a steel base that houses the LED source and supports a blown glass diffuser. In the upper part of the glass, a pin allows you to change the position of the sphere, to orient the light beam and its intensity.

name.ru: Подвесной светильник Beam Stick Nuance Balloton 350
name.en: Beam Stick Nuance Balloton 350 suspension lamp

text.en:
Three-dimensional glass
Beam Stick Nuance Balloton 350 is the new OLEV mouth-blown glass lamp, worked by hand. What makes it unique is the glass sphere’s particular effect that creates a raised criss-cross pattern on the glass, almost like a soft padded fabric. The hollow sphere contains a dual light source that allows a gentle glow to softly filter from the inside, and at the same time projects an unfiltered light beam downwards. Beam Stick Nuance Balloton 350 is a statement piece blending modern design with age-old artisan crafts. Each glass sphere is molded by the master glassmakers who keep the ancient Venetian art alive, giving life to a one-of-a-kind, Italian-Made object with great artistic value.

Exagon Silence is designed to furnish and make public places such as airports, lounge areas, offices, restaurants and educational spaces comfortable.

Reproduces Sunlight...
We humans evolved outdoors, regulating our vital functions and our sleep-wake cycle based precisely on sunlight. The Exagon Biolight lamp automatically reproduces the natural variation of sunlight throughout the day. This helps our body properly regulate its bio-rhythm, enhancing overall mental and physical well-being

Cold light, warm light
Our eyes, stimulated by the light they receive, signal the time of day to the brain, triggering the production of specific hormones: Cortisol (the energy and alertness hormone): Stimulated by white/cool light. Melatonin (the sleep and recovery hormone): Stimulated by warm tones. By mimicking natural light variations, the Exagon Biolight lamp helps the body produce the right hormone at the right time, improving daytime concentration and nighttime rest.

Physical and mental wellbeing
By replicating the shifts in natural sunlight, it helps the body regulate different states of alertness or relaxation. It doesn't just provide light; it improves your quality of life by optimizing the sleep-wake cycle, reducing stress, and boosting emotional well-being.

Additionally, the lamp features an internal paneling made of micro-perforated sheet metal with sound-absorbing properties, helping to reduce ambient noise.

Elegant glass
Expertly handcrafted, the glass is softened by thin grooved stripes. Trisel expresses a sense of transparency and elegance. This pendant lamp is a combination of glass and metal, a union of lightweight and slender parts.

Vetro elegante

Tubelia is the designer wall lamp by OLEV that reimagines the essential geometry of the cylinder. Featuring two parallel tubular elements, this applique provides a sophisticated dual light emission : a soft glow is cast both upwards and downwards, creating evocative patterns of light and shadow on the walls. Perfect for illuminating hallways, living areas, or staircases in residential and contract settings, Tubelia is available in various metallic finishes to seamlessly complement any interior design project.

Zoella is the outdoor floor lamp shaped like a leaf or a flower bud , ideal for elegantly illuminating gardens, parks, terraces, and flower beds. Nestled among tall grass, blooming bushes, and garden borders, Zoella blends seamlessly into its surroundings , merging with the vegetation until it becomes part of the scenery itself. By day, it honors the landscape’s natural harmony as if it were a plant sprung directly from the earth; by night, it reveals its radiant soul. Thanks to its slender and flexible stem, the lamp sways gently with the breeze , perfectly mimicking the natural motion of a flower in the wind.
